requirement.description: The __hash__ method assumes val is a SplitResult object with path and netloc attributes, but during unpickling from __setstate__, val can be a tuple. This causes AttributeError when accessing .path on a tuple.
requirement.contract: The __hash__ method should check the type of val and handle both SplitResult objects and tuples properly when computing the hash. During unpickling, val will be a tuple containing the SplitResult, so it should extract the SplitResult from the tuple.

requirement.description: The with_suffix method incorrectly rejects empty suffix strings with ValueError. According to the test, empty suffix should be accepted and treated as removing the suffix.
requirement.contract: The with_suffix method should accept empty suffix strings and treat them as removing the suffix (equivalent to setting suffix to None).

requirement.description: The with_suffix method double-encodes percent characters when processing already encoded URLs. The URL is already encoded but the method applies additional encoding.
requirement.contract: The with_suffix method should properly handle already-encoded URLs without double-encoding them.

requirement.description: The test directly assigns to _scheme attribute, but this is not how URL objects should be initialized. The test creates a URL object via URL.__new__ and then directly assigns private attributes, which is incorrect usage.
requirement.contract: The URL class should properly initialize objects through its constructor or factory methods, and the test should not directly assign to private attributes.
